_comment: Bread category config — TASK-322 spine conformance. Bread is the last bespoke category; this config conforms it to the uniform generate_page path. Source: real_bread_retail_003_v1 (Shufersal, 25 May 2026), 258 BSIP0 → 31 curated → 29 scoreable (2 excluded: no nutrition in BSIP0 scrape). BSIP1: run_bread_conform_001 (31 records, direct Shufersal scrape). BSIP2: run_bread_conform_001 (31 scored). baseline_json set to canonical bari-web copy (19 products with authored Hebrew copy) — copy_stage carries insightLine/rowVerdict/bottomLine for 19/29 overlapping products; 10 new-to-page products get PENDING_COPY. OFF: 0 (nutrition+ingredients from direct scrape only). Scores move vs lechem bespoke scorer — EXPECTED (owner approved 2026-06-18). Flag set: grain/non-dairy (mirrors cereals — RECAL_P0=on, FAT_TECH=on, no shelf-rel, no dairy flags). BARI_SHELF_RELATIVE_V1=off rationale: bread has no single saturated-fat shelf-differentiator; sodium matters but GRAD_SODIUM is not yet evidence-approved; keep disabled per cereals precedent. No BARI_SODIUM_CEREAL (bread is not in the cereal pool). CORRECTION 2026-06-22: baseline_json re-pointed from bread_frontend_v2.json (19 products, stale) to bread_frontend_v3.json — the file the live app actually imports (bread-comparison-page-data.ts + admin/fields.ts); v2 had drifted out of service while the config still targeted it (conformance HARD-3 violation caught by the D4 red-team gate). NOTE 2026-07-01 (TASK-433): crackers split to a standalone category; a membership-correction-only bread_frontend_v4.json (23 survivors, byte-identical scores/grades to v3, brand injected on 2 new + 1 pre-existing, rank renumbered 1..23) was produced at C:\Bari\bari-web\src\data\comparisons\bread_frontend_v4.json via build_bread_v4_membership_correction.py — NOT via this config/pipeline (a full re-score through this config was found to drift one survivor -0.8 pts due to an unrelated router rule added after v3's publication, so re-scoring was explicitly rejected). baseline_json below is NOT yet re-pointed to v4 — that live-route cutover is a go-live/wiring decision for Frontend/Product, out of Data Agent's lane; this config still describes the v3 scoring lineage (which remains the score-of-record) plus the 6 cracker-removal exclusions for any FUTURE re-derive. CORRECTION 2026-07-11 (TASK-629): baseline_json re-pointed from bread_frontend_v3.json to bread_frontend_v4.json. v4 (not v3) is the file the live app actually imports (confirmed: bread-comparison-page-data.ts, admin/fields.ts, public-corpus-registry.ts all import v4 only); v3 is stale/unserved for consumer pages. This config's baseline_json was pointing at the wrong (unserved) file, which meant the Product Dossier compiler (build_dossiers.py, which reads baseline_json to source the served product for its publication_record axis) was building bread's PD from stale v3 data. Re-pointed to v4 so PD/comparison/catalog parity (parity_gate.py) is checked against what is actually live. v3 itself is left untouched (still referenced by a few legacy admin/SEO scripts outside this pipeline's scope) — only this config's pointer moved.
